subject: Kickoff: abbreviation-aware normalization from the survey release
body:
Hi Bao,

Kicking off the abbreviation project. We're building on our open-source survey release: survey.tsv has consultant-level responses across 19 columns per locale — whether a locale has first-character abbreviations (NATO-style), stump compounds (FiDi < Financial District), truncations (Col. < Colonel), augmented truncations (footie < football), word-internal deletions (Blvd.), plus examples for each. Locale codes like ru, ja, pt-br.

Product goal: an abbreviation-aware text normalization model for the language portfolio's keyboard and TTS pipelines — expand or preserve abbreviations per locale conventions instead of today's one-size-fits-all rules.

Rough milestones: survey-to-features pipeline by mid-April, per-locale rule baselines by end of May, multilingual model trained in early July, readout before 07-20. Compute ask comes from your side once the model config settles.

Priya
